steps: 2. At the top of the page, click Select a project.
3. Click Create a new project > type Project Name > Create > Select project
4. In the search bar, find Google Drive API and click Enable.
5. Go to APIs & Services > OAuth consent screen >Get Started.
6. Enter App name: jira-report and your email as the support email > Next.
8. Enter your email again as the contact email, check the agreement box > Continue > Create.
9. Go to the Data Access tab > click Add or Remove Scopes > find and select  .../auth/drive.file > Update > Save.
10. Go to the Audience tab > Scroll to Test users > add your Google Drive email > Save.
11. Go to the Clients tab > click Create Client > choose Desktop app > name it > Create.
12. Copy Client secret(only shown once) and download the JSON.
13. Open the downloaded JSON file in TextEdit or Notepad and paste its full contents here.
